title: Periodic Delaunay cylinders with constant anisotropic nonlocal mean curvature
summary: In this article we prove existence and symmetry properties of periodic surfaces of revolution with constant anisotropic nonlocal mean curvature, generalizing a classical result of Delaunay to the anisotropic nonlocal setting. First, by studying the corresponding periodic isoperimetric problem, under natural assumptions on the kernel, we use rearrangement inequalities to extend a periodic version of the Wulff inequality to the nonlocal setting.
